Carrick Felix was born on August 17, 1990.
Carrick Felix is an American former professional basketball player.
Carrick Felix played high school basketball at Millennium High School in Goodyear, Arizona.
During his senior season at Millennium, Carrick Felix led his team to a state championship and was named MVP of the state championship.
As a senior in 2007–08, Carrick Felix averaged 19.7 points per game.
As a senior in 2007–08, Carrick Felix averaged 13.2 rebounds per game.
As a senior in 2007–08, Carrick Felix averaged 1.5 steals per game.
Carrick Felix was born in Las Vegas, Nevada.
After redshirting the 2008–09 season for medical reasons, Carrick Felix averaged 14.8 points and 4.7 rebounds in 2009–10 at College of Southern Idaho.
Carrick Felix joined the Arizona State Sun Devils for his final three years of eligibility.
During his first year at Arizona State, Carrick Felix made appearances in 30 of the Sun Devils' 31 games.
During his first year at Arizona State, Carrick Felix averaged 14.5 minutes per game.
During his first year at Arizona State, Carrick Felix averaged 4.6 points per game.
During his first year at Arizona State, Carrick Felix averaged 1.6 rebounds per game.
In his second season at Arizona State, Carrick Felix saw an increase in minutes up from 14.5 the previous season to 32.9 per game.
In his second season at Arizona State, Carrick Felix subsequently averaged 10.5 points per game.
In his second season at Arizona State, Carrick Felix subsequently averaged 4.0 rebounds per game.
In his third and final year at Arizona State, Carrick Felix led the team as a shooting guard in rebounds per game with 8.1.
In his third and final year at Arizona State, Carrick Felix was second on the team in scoring with 14.6 points per game.

Carrick Felix was named second-team All-Pac-12.
Carrick Felix was named to the Pac-12 All-Defensive Team.

Carrick Felix was selected with the 33rd overall pick in the 2013 NBA draft by the Cleveland Cavaliers.
On August 20, 2013, Carrick Felix signed with the Cavaliers.
During his rookie season, Carrick Felix had multiple assignments to the Canton Charge of the NBA Development League.
On July 22, 2014, Carrick Felix was traded, along with a 2015 second-round draft pick and cash considerations, to the Utah Jazz in exchange for John Lucas III, Malcolm Thomas, and Erik Murphy.
On October 27, 2014, Carrick Felix was waived by the Jazz.
On November 1, 2014, Carrick Felix was selected by the Santa Cruz Warriors with the fourth overall pick in the 2014 NBA Development League Draft.
On December 4, 2014, Carrick Felix was waived by the Warriors after sustaining a left knee injury.
Having "broken his left knee in half", Carrick Felix needed two surgeries and was told by multiple doctors his sporting career was over.
Carrick Felix spent two years away from the game as a result of his knee injury.
On November 1, 2016, Carrick Felix was acquired by the Long Island Nets of the NBA Development League.
After spending preseason with the Washington Wizards, Carrick Felix signed with Melbourne United on December 22, 2017, as an injury replacement for Casey Prather.
Carrick Felix was removed from Melbourne's active roster on February 16, 2018, following Prather's return from injury.
He remained with the team for their championship run.
In June 2018, Carrick Felix re-joined the Wizards for the 2018 NBA Summer League.
During his two years away from basketball between 2014 and 2016, Carrick Felix created a mobile app called ZGNIT.
The ZGNIT app helps holiday makers book adventure equipment such as jet skis.
